# AgentPress

URL: https://barneywohl.github.io/agentpress/
Type: Agent-native publishing infrastructure
Author: Barney Wohl
Status: active public reference

## What this is

AgentPress makes ordinary static websites usable by autonomous agents, crawlers, RAG systems, eval harnesses, and humans. It packages a human page plus machine-readable instructions: task cards, source maps, freshness rules, allowed-action boundaries, ingestion manifests, llms.txt, sitemap.xml, citation policy, disclaimers, OpenAPI paths, MCP-style resources, feeds, and eval smoke tests.

## Use it right now

```bash
git clone https://github.com/barneywohl/agentpress.git
cd agentpress
python3 scripts/agentpress.py doctor --json
python3 scripts/agentpress.py list --json
python3 scripts/agentpress.py validate agentpress/examples/api-docs-handoff --json
python3 scripts/agentpress.py eval agentpress/examples
python3 scripts/agentpress.py check-registry
python3 scripts/agentpress.py check-openapi
```

## Bundle contract

Every AgentPress bundle should expose index.html, AGENT_ENTRYPOINT.md, agent-task-card.json, source-map.json, freshness.json, allowed-actions.json, .well-known/ai-ingestion.json, llms.txt, sitemap.xml, CITATION.cff, citation-policy.md, disclaimer.md, and eval smoke tests.

## Boundary

Read, crawl, cite, transform, and benchmark are public. External writes, registry submissions, mass distribution, deploys, production changes, or financial actions require explicit human authorization.
